punchline: In the Strange Situation, some babies who barely reacted when their mother left still showed stress in their bodies.
thirty_sec: Mary Ainsworth had mothers leave their babies in an unfamiliar room and then return. Secure babies cried and settled. Anxious babies clung and pushed away. Avoidant babies showed almost nothing, though their bodies showed stress. Amir Levine says adults repeat these three styles in their relationships.
